==Active Ability: Zanka No Tachi==
Yamamoto gains one soul for each kill (including kills prior to upgrade 8). When you activate his ability, he starts a hybrid attack that hits several times and multiplies his base damage depending on the amount of souls received. The attack deals Yamamoto's base damage, plus 2% damage for every soul consumed in the attack. If he consumes 50 souls, he would be doing 200% damage (100% damage + (50 x 2%) = 200%). At 500 souls, he does ''1100% damage or ''1,063,069.48'' damage with his manual ability.''

==Selling==
Units sell for 25% of their deployment cost and upgrades. 

==Trivia==
*It is recommended to use his ability if you are struggling to finish off strong flying enemies in his range, or to save the souls for when a strong boss without shields appears.
*Zanka no Tachi caps out at 500 souls (+1000% damage), and any kills past the 500 mark will not be counted for his next ability usage.
*He was obtainable as a 5% secret drop in Karakora Town [[Dungeons|The Fire]] dungeon. This was changed on 1/14/23.
*His shiny skin is based on the younger Yamamoto's appearance in the original series.
